metas.name: Boston Legal
metas.description: Boston Legal is a spin-off of the long-running David E. Kelley series The Practice (1997), following the exploits of former Practice character Alan Shore (James Spader) at the legal firm of Crane, Poole, and Schmidt.

metas.name: Kotaro Lives Alone
metas.description: A lonely little boy moves into a ramshackle apartment building all on his own and makes friends with the broke manga artist who lives next door.

metas.name: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
metas.description: The proudly privileged top two students of an elite school each makes it their mission to be the first to extract a confession of love from the other.

metas.name: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
metas.description: After her husband leaves her, young mother of two Miriam "Midge" Maisel discovers that she has a talent for stand-up comedy. Could this be her calling?

metas.name: Fallout

metas.name: Poker Face
metas.description: Charlie has an extraordinary ability to determine when someone is lying. She hits the road with her Plymouth Barracuda and at every stop encounters a new cast of characters and strange crimes that she can't help but investigate an...

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: A grieving therapist starts to tell his clients exactly what he thinks. Ignoring his training and ethics, he finds himself making huge changes to people's lives - including his own.

metas.name: The Studio
metas.description: Follows a legacy Hollywood movie studio striving to survive in a world where it is increasingly difficult for art and business to live together.

metas.name: Code Geass
metas.description: After being given a mysterious power to control others, an outcast prince becomes the masked leader of the rebellion against an all-powerful empire.

metas.name: Nada
metas.description: An iconic bon vivant, who barely has enough resources to maintain his affluent lifestyle, hires a young woman from Paraguay to replace the recently deceased maid who took care of him for more than 40 years.

metas.name: High Potential
metas.description: A single mom with three kids helps solve an unsolvable crime when she rearranges some evidence during her shift as a police department cleaner.

metas.name: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
metas.description: Mahiru is so beautiful that they call her "angel", Amane is an average boy who has never thought much about beauty, but everything changes when he sees Mahiru during a storm, and an incredible and unlikely relationship begins.

links.name: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten

metas.name: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
metas.description: A divorced mom gets caught up in a perilous web of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

metas.name: High School
metas.description: A story about finding your own identity—a journey made even more complicated when you have a twin whose own struggle and self-discovery so closely mimics your own. Told through a backdrop of ‘90s grunge and rave culture, the series weaves between parallel and discordant memories of sisters growing up down the hall from one another. Based on the autobiographical book High School by musicians Tegan and Sara.

metas.name: Average Joe
metas.description: Blue-collar plumber Joe learns that his recently-deceased father lived a secret life and stole millions from dangerous people--who now think that Joe has the money. He must race against time to find the truth and the money.

metas.name: Shoresy
metas.description: Sees the foul-mouthed, chirp-serving, mother-loving, fan favorite character, Shoresy, join a senior AAA hockey team in Sudbury on a quest to never lose again.

metas.name: Love on the Spectrum U.S.
metas.description: It follows people on the autism spectrum as they navigate the world of dating and relationships.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description: "RIFIFI" is inspired by the notorious bank robbery that took place in Athens in 1992. Who carried it out and why? The authorities spoke of organized crime, terrorist groups, and highly educated, ruthless perpetrators. But was it really like that? Through the power of fiction, the new production by COSMOTE TV combines the biggest heist ever committed in Greece with a true story of human tragedy, creating a character-driven series full of emotion and strong elements of humor.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
metas.description: Malcolm and his daughter are drawn into the family's chaos when Hal and Lois demand his presence for their 40th wedding anniversary party.

links.name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair

metas.name: Steins;Gate
metas.description: After discovering time travel, a university student and his colleagues must use their knowledge of it to stop an evil organization and their diabolical plans.

metas.name: Lucky Hank
metas.description: An English department chairman at an underfunded college, Professor Hank Devereaux toes the line between midlife crisis and full-blown meltdown, navigating the offbeat chaos in his personal and professional life.

metas.name: Freaks and Geeks
metas.description: A high school mathlete starts hanging out with a group of burnouts while her younger brother navigates his freshman year.

metas.name: The Good Bad Mother

metas.name: Your Lie in April
metas.description: A piano prodigy who lost his ability to play after suffering a traumatic event in his childhood is forced back into the spotlight by an eccentric girl with a secret of her own.

Lucky for him, his manager and best friend Andy Lujan is determined to get him back on top. But when a nefarious organization rears its head, the stakes of this rematch become life or death. Esteban must juggle his own personal demons and protect his family.

metas.name: Common Side Effects
metas.description: Two former classmates uncover a sinister conspiracy to destroy a mushroom that can cure all the world's diseases.

metas.name: Fruits Basket

metas.name: Great Teacher Onizuka
metas.description: About Eikichi Onizuka, a 22-year-old ex-gangster member and a virgin. He has one ambition that no one ever expected from him. His sole life purpose is to become the greatest high school teacher ever.

metas.name: The Bear
metas.description: A young chef from the fine dining world returns to Chicago to run his family's sandwich shop.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep whose darling partner Clea disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: When I Fly Towards You
metas.description: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang — her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

metas.name: Duang with You

metas.name: Ludwig
metas.description: While seeking to unravel the mystery of his twin brother's disappearance, reclusive puzzle-designer John 'Ludwig' Taylor takes on his twin brother James's identity as DCI on Cambridge's major crimes squad.

metas.name: Kingdom

metas.name: Scrubs

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: JD and Turk scrub in together after a long break. Medicine and interns have evolved, but their friendship remains strong. New and familiar faces at Sacred Heart bring laughs, emotion, and unexpected moments.

metas.name: Big Boys

metas.name: Home Movies

metas.name: Land of Women

metas.name: Murderbot
metas.description: A security android struggles with emotions and free will while balancing dangerous missions and desire for isolation, evading detection of its self-hacking as it finds its place.

metas.name: The Last Man on Earth

metas.name: iZombie

metas.name: Horimiya

links.name: This World Can't Tear Me Down

metas.name: Cheers

metas.name: Elsbeth

links.name: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

links.name: Fight Night: The Million Dollar Heist

No sooner do they embark on their honeymoon than she meets and develops an instant connection with Casaubon's young cousin, Will Ladislaw. When idealistic Doctor Lydgate arrives, his new methods of medicine sweep him into the battle between conservatives and liberals in town. He quickly becomes enamored of the beautiful, privileged Rosamond Vincy, a woman whose troubles seem bound to destroy him.

links.name: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

metas.description: It is an unique and heartwarming show follows the extraordinary journey of a couple named Leyla and Mecnun. With Ali Atay portraying Mecnun and Ezgi Asaroglu as Leyla, the series has garnered a massive fan base and critical acclaim.

metas.description: Two movie enthusiasts, Noa and Evie, share a weekly film club where their unspoken feelings for each other grow. When Noa decides to move away for work, Evie has a limited time to confess her love before potentially losing him for...

Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyeong-do now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

links.name: Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun

metas.description: Limited series adaptation of the classic Joseph Heller novel. Follows Captain John Yossarian and airmen in World War II.

metas.name: The Gilded Age
metas.description: The conflicts surrounding the new money Russell family and their old money neighbors, the van Rhijn family, in 1880s New York City high society.

metas.name: The Tatami Galaxy
metas.description: When a nameless student at Kyoto University encounters a demigod one night, he asks to relive the past three years in order to win the heart of Ms. Akashi, the object of his affection.

metas.name: High Desert
metas.description: Peggy, a former addict, who decides to make a new start after the death of her beloved mother with whom she lived in the small desert town of Yucca Valley, California, makes a life-changing decision to become a private investigator.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description: The story of an office that faces closure when the company decides to downsize its branches. A documentary film crew follow staff and the manager David Brent as they continue their daily lives.

metas.name: Staged
metas.description: David Tennant and Michael Sheen star as two actors whose West End play has been put on hold due to Covid-19, but whose director has persuaded them to carry on rehearsing online.

metas.name: Eerie, Indiana
metas.description: Teenage weirdness investigator Marshall Teller adventures through his new small-town home with his friends, geeky Simon Holmes and mysterious Dash X.

metas.name: Castle
metas.description: Successful author Richard Castle teams up with NYPD Detective Kate Beckett to solve complex murder cases.

metas.name: Monk
metas.description: Adrian Monk is a brilliant former San Francisco detective, who now consults the police as a private consultant while battling with an obsessive-compulsive disorder.

metas.name: To Catch a Predator
metas.description: To catch a predator shows us the investigations carried out using the hidden camera from Dateline NBC.

metas.name: House of the Dragon
metas.description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

metas.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
metas.description: A young woman, destined to slay vampires, demons and other infernal creatures, deals with her life fighting evil, with the help of her friends.
